import json,time
import torch
from topoformer.campaign_semantics_s19_actor import TypedRecordActor
from topoformer.campaign_semantics_s19_codec import NODE,EOS,KINDS
from topoformer.campaign_semantics_s22_controller import NodeCount,NodeKinds,NodePrefix,decode
from topoformer.thinking_language import ActorInput,state_hash
start=time.monotonic();torch.set_num_threads(2);torch.manual_seed(220023)
assert not torch.cuda.is_available()
m=TypedRecordActor(value_count=4,width=1024,heads=8,node_capacity=128,max_records=160,max_slot=32,autocast_dtype='bfloat16');m.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
 for name,index in [('type',2),('kind',KINDS.index('record')),('value',1)]:
  h=getattr(m,name+'_head');h.weight.zero_();h.bias.fill_(-100);h.bias[index]=100
before=state_hash(m);publics=[ActorInput('alice bob',()),ActorInput('alice bob carol',())]
noop=decode(m,publics);assert [{k:r[k]for k in ('records','status','node_count')}for r in noop]==m.greedy(publics)
boundaries={'oracle_node_count':[NodeCount(1),NodeCount(2)],'oracle_node_kinds':[NodeKinds((KINDS.index('record'),)),NodeKinds((KINDS.index('ident'),KINDS.index('record')))],'oracle_node_prefix':[NodePrefix(((NODE,KINDS.index('record'),1,-1,-1),)),NodePrefix(((NODE,KINDS.index('ident'),-1,2,-1),(NODE,KINDS.index('record'),2,-1,-1)))]}
results={}
for policy,bindings in boundaries.items():
 batch=decode(m,publics,policy,bindings);single=[decode(m,[p],policy,[b])[0]for p,b in zip(publics,bindings)]
 assert batch==single and [r['node_count']for r in batch]==[1,2]
 assert all(r['status']=='eos'and r['records'][-1][0]==EOS for r in batch)
 assert all(all(x[0]==NODE for x in r['records'][:-1])for r in batch)
 if policy=='oracle_node_prefix':assert all(r['records'][:-1]==[list(x)for x in b.records]for r,b in zip(batch,bindings))
 assert state_hash(m)==before
 results[policy]={'batch_individual_equal':True,'counts':[1,2],'strict_eos':True,'state_unchanged':True}
print(json.dumps({'width':m.width,'heads':8,'dtype':'bfloat16','parameters':sum(p.numel()for p in m.parameters()),'cuda_available':torch.cuda.is_available(),'no_op_parity':True,'policies':results,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'scope':'Random mechanical model with deliberately fixed output heads, no learned checkpoint or corpus outcomes'}))
